title: Motor Vehicle Information – Registrar’s decisions and notifications
text:
Motor vehicle information
Overview
A Registrar’s Decision Notification (RDN) is a public notice that explains when the Registrar may release certain motor vehicle information, what information may be released, who may receive it, and why. It gives Albertans transparency about how their information may be shared and provides an opportunity to request a review through the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner within the required review period.
Decisions and notifications
Listed below are the decisions and notifications issued by the Registrar of Motor Vehicles.
Registrar’s Decisions: Notification 02/2026 (RDN 02/2026)
– New as of June 29, 2026
Alberta is the first Canadian jurisdiction to require the display of the Canadian Citizenship Marker (CM) – ‘CAN’ – on driver’s licences and identification cards (ID cards). Alberta is also requiring Albertans to add their Personal Health Numbers (PHNs) on their driver’s licences and identification cards.
Neither the CM nor the PHN is considered personal driving and motor vehicle information, as defined in the
Traffic Safety Act
